parsed.rationale: Tech-specific signals are conflicted: AI capex/credit concerns and heavy equity supply weigh on QQQ, while premarket strength and earnings growth support. Fed and mega-cap earnings create binary event risk, leaving close-to-close odds near neutral with a slight bearish tilt.
